body: I'm guessing this could be related to Agroal's background health check for JDBC connections. @barreiro @stalep ?

hm, @barreiro is on PTO this week, but I know he implemented a `maxLifeTime` feature in Agroal 1.5. Before that it never timed out AFAIK which do look like this issue here. @enbohm do you mind testing with the latest version of Quarkus? I know we use Agral 1.5 in that version.
@stalep sure - I will update to the latest version and see the result. I'll keep you posted, thx!
@gsmet do we have a `quarkus.datasource.max-life-time` or something similar for connections in Quarkus now or a default maxLifeTime?

I don't think it got implemented. I'm creating an issue.

But that being said, isn't Agroal supposed to test the connections regularly anyway?
@stalep just checked the logs from my Quarkus 0.18.0 service and unfortunately the issue is still there
We need to check if the connections are properly validated by the Agroal logic.

> just checked the logs from my Quarkus 0.18.0 service and unfortunately the issue is still there

@enbohm did you enable the new configuration properties?

```
quarkus.datasource.max-life-time 
```

And how did you set other existing properties? These could be related, but I guess we could use to see them all.
```
quarkus.datasource.background-validation-interval
quarkus.datasource.idle-removal-interval
```

@Sanne 

These are the properties I have
```
quarkus.datasource.url=jdbc:mariadb://some-url...
quarkus.datasource.driver=org.mariadb.jdbc.Driver
quarkus.hibernate-orm.dialect=org.hibernate.dialect.MariaDB102Dialect
quarkus.datasource.background-validation-interval=PT1M
quarkus.datasource.idle-removal-interval=PT1M
quarkus.datasource.username=someUserName
quarkus.datasource.password=somePwd
```

I have not tried
```
quarkus.datasource.max-life-time
```
but will enabled it and see the outcome. Will update with the result within a few days, ok?
